item.title: Two St. Johns County Inmates Charged for Planning Attempt to Escape from Jail
item.description: Two inmates were charged after planning an attempted escape from the St. Johns County jail. Deputies found improvised tools during a routine check. Investigation ongoing.

item.title: SJSO Hosts Community Safety Forum at Nocatee
item.description: Deputies will host a free community safety forum covering home security and neighborhood watch programs. Residents are encouraged to attend.
